output_list.criticism: The function _addguess() is publicly callable. It can be called by anyone to add guesses. However, the game state is only Started. Only guesses should be added when the game is Started. If _addguess() is called accidentally, it will cost the attacker a lot of money. The better way is to make _addguess() internal or private, and only be callable by the contract itself.

The function _finish() is publicly callable. It can be called by anyone to finish the current game. However, the game state is only Locked. Only finish() should be called when the game is Locked. If _finish() is called accidentally, it will cost the attacker a lot of money. The better way is to make _finish() internal or private, and only be callable by the contract itself.

In _finish(), function findWinner(uint value) is used to find the winner based on the hash value. However, the hash value (curhash) is based on block timestamp, block coinbase, block difficulty and curhash itself, which is predictable. If the attacker tries to make the guesses array full and call _finish() frequently, he can predict the winner and make the money from the lottery. The better way is to use a truly random number generation to choose the winner.
